description: This file defines the Locator and FrameLocator classes used for element selection and interaction within a web automation framework, including methods for element querying, actions, and attribute retrieval.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: Represents a selector for locating elements within a frame, providing methods for element interaction, attribute access, and chaining locators.

classes.name: FrameLocator
classes.description: Represents a locator scoped to a specific frame, allowing for nested element queries within that frame.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Locator with a frame, selector, and optional options for filtering.

methods.name: _withElement
methods.description: Executes a task with an element handle, managing timeouts and disposal.

methods.name: _equals
methods.description: Checks if another locator is equivalent based on frame and selector.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the page associated with the locator's frame.

methods.name: boundingBox
methods.description: Retrieves the bounding box of the element.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks a checkbox or radio button element.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates a click on the element.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Simulates a double-click on the element.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a DOM event of a specified type.

methods.name: dragTo
methods.description: Performs a drag-and-drop operation to a target locator.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the context of the element.

methods.name: evaluateAll
methods.description: Evaluates a function on all elements matching the selector.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Returns a handle to the result of evaluating a function.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element with a specified value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input element.

methods.name: _highlight
methods.description: Highlights the element (used internally).

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights the element.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Creates a chained locator relative to the current one.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with a specific test ID.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific alt text.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific label text.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific placeholder text.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific visible text.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with specific title text.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Returns a locator for elements with a specific ARIA role.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a FrameLocator scoped to a nested frame.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the current locator with additional options.

methods.name: elementHandle
methods.description: Returns an element handle for the first matching element.

methods.name: elementHandles
methods.description: Returns all element handles matching the selector.

methods.name: contentFrame
methods.description: Returns a FrameLocator for a nested frame.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Adds a description to the locator.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the description of the locator.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a locator for the first element.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a locator for the last element.

methods.name: nth
methods.description: Returns a locator for the element at the specified index.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Combines locators with logical AND.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Combines locators with logical OR.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the element.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from the element.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of matching elements.

methods.name: toCode
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the locator.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value from the element.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over the element.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Gets the inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Gets the inner text of the element.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Gets the current value of an input element.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if a checkbox or radio is checked.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if the element is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is enabled.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if the element is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the element is visible.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the element.

methods.name: ariaSnapshot
methods.description: Returns an ARIA snapshot of the element.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the element into view if needed.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a select element.

methods.name: selectText
methods.description: Selects text within the element.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Checks or unchecks a checkbox.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for a file input element.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on the element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Gets the text content of the element.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the element.

methods.name: pressSequentially
methods.description: Types text sequentially.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks a checkbox.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all locators matching the current selector.

methods.name: allInnerTexts
methods.description: Returns inner texts of all matched elements.

methods.name: allTextContents
methods.description: Returns text contents of all matched elements.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Waits for the element to meet a certain state.

methods.name: _expect
methods.description: Performs an expectation check on the element.

methods.name: _inspect
methods.description: Returns a string representation for inspection.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string description of the locator.
